description: Unit test class for the LeaveRequestCommentDao, testing CRUD operations and data retrieval for leave request comments and leave comments within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveRequestCommentDao's methods related to leave request comments and leave comments.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of LeaveRequestCommentDao, and populates test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Tests searching leave request comments by leave request ID and verifies the order and number of results.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Tests saving a new leave request comment and verifies the returned object has correct properties.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveRequestCommentsCount
methods.description: Tests counting leave request comments based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a leave request by ID, checking for existing and non-existing records.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveComment
methods.description: Tests searching leave comments by leave ID and verifies the order and number of results.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveComment
methods.description: Tests saving a new leave comment and verifies the object's properties.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveCommentsCount
methods.description: Tests counting leave comments based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetLeaveById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a leave by ID, checking for existing and non-existing records.
